subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min product demo
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + 30-min demo - proposed times

Hi Oliver - thanks again for taking time to chat today. Quick recap from my side:

- Pain: team struggling with inconsistent latency and high per-token costs on peak batch workloads for your customer-facing assistants.
- Goal: reduce inference cost while keeping 95th percentile latency under 250ms; evaluate private deployment options for sensitive PII workloads.
- Stakeholders: you (AI/ML lead), Priya (Infra), and optionally Priya's manager or a security contact for compliance questions.

We recommend a short 30-minute product demo + technical deep-dive where we'll:
1) Walk through Redwood's serving runtime and how we control latency/cost (caching, batching, quant profiles)
2) Show a quick config for a similar workload and expected unit economics
3) Discuss next steps (MVP pilot + MLP/POC scoping)

Proposed 30-min slots (PT) - pick one that works for you and Priya, and we'll send calendar invite:
- Tue, May 26: 10:00 - 10:30 AM PT
- Tue, May 26: 2:00 - 2:30 PM PT
- Wed, May 27: 9:00 - 9:30 AM PT

If none of those work, let me know alternative windows and which stakeholders should join. Attaching a one-pager and a starter mutual action plan for timing/owners.

Attachment: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 35KB)

Thanks - happy to adapt the agenda based on who joins.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com
